observation.visible_scene: A close, slightly tilted overhead view of a white dish/plate holding a pool of dark reddish-brown liquid with orange-yellow swirls. Three pale wooden craft/popsicle sticks lie in or on the liquid: one angled down-left with a rounded white paddle end at the lower left, one short vertical stick in the center, and one angled down-right forming a V with the left stick over the brightest orange area. A small pink smudge sits on the dry white surface at the upper left. The framing stays on the same region for the whole excerpt.
visible_changes: The three sticks keep essentially the same positions and orientations relative to each other and to the dish; no clear translation, rotation, lifting or insertion is visible.

The orange-yellow region within the dark liquid changes shape and brightness only very slowly and subtly from frame to frame (the boundary between the orange swirl and the dark red pool shifts slightly), consistent with slow fluid movement or lighting rather than a rapid action.

The right diagonal stick appears as a thin bright line in the earlier frames and as a wider flat paddle outline in the later frames; this looks like a change in how much of the stick is revealed by the liquid/reflection rather than the stick itself moving.
The white dish edge and the pink smudge at upper left remain in fixed screen positions, indicating the camera is largely stationary with only minor jitter.
No onset, contact, removal, or completion of any stick-handling action occurs within the excerpt; the arrangement is already established at the first frame and persists to the last.
outside_clip_unknowns: What placed or arranged the sticks and the liquids before this segment.
Whether the sticks are later moved, removed, or used to stir.
The identity of the liquids/materials and any intended outcome.
uncertain_details: Whether the slight apparent widening of the right stick is real stick motion, a change in liquid coverage/reflection, or camera-angle drift.
Whether the slow orange-shape change is genuine mixing, settling, or just lighting/shadow variation.
Whether the tiny position differences of the sticks across frames are object motion or sub-pixel camera jitter.
